repo.description:
### Impact

A missing ownership check allowed an attack to take-away a 2FA webauthn device when correctly guessing a 80-128 character long random string of letters, numbers and symbols. The victim would then be prompted to register a new device on the next login. The attacker can **not** authenticate as the victim.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Twofactor WebAuthn app is upgraded to 1.4.2 or 2.4.1.

### Workarounds

* No workaround available

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3360354)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/twofactor_webauthn/pull/881)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: WebAuthn app was updated based on public key
